title: Pack spec
description: The real pack, as a file (F86): sizes in mm from the dieline, the converter's print file or a measurement, never invented. The make gate needs an approved one before any pack render, and `cstack pack check` measures outputs against it.

product.description: which product and size this pack holds

front_mm.description: the face seen front-on (for a can: diameter by label height)

flat_mm.description: the flat print size of the artwork (dieline trim, or a can's full wrap: circumference by label height)

height_mm.description: overall height of the object, when it differs from the front face

repeat_mm.description: the packing machine's repeat for a flow-pack or label web

seals.description: crimps, fin seals, lids: where they sit and how deep

material.description: the base material and its colour where no ink covers it (bare aluminium, white PE, kraft)

kind.description: guess never passes the make gate

file.description: the file the sizes were read from, relative to the workspace or a path on the owner's machine

photos.description: owner-confirmed photos of the real pack

artwork_mismatch.description: when the current artwork's size differs from the print file or the machine repeat: an owner decision (re-lay the face, or change the repeat), never one an image model makes
